title: Coverage Map
description: Per-golden path-tree showing which skills' last runs touched which files/folders. Reveals overlap (paths touched by multiple skills) and gaps (paths no skill exercises).

requirements.title: Path aggregation + tree view
requirements.description: Aggregate the most-recent validation diffs per skill per golden into a path → [skills] map; render as a collapsible tree with per-node skill chips and overlap counts.
